headline: Jinkushal Industries Limited: SEBI Takeover Regulation 10(5) Disclosure Filed
sum: JKIPL has filed a mandatory Regulation 10(5) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares. Acquirer identity, consideration, and shareholding acquired not accessible from available sources.
implication: Regulation 10(5) filings signal completion of a substantial acquisition threshold (typically ≥25% shareholding in listed companies); this disclosure gates public information about the acquirer and triggers potential open offer obligations if shareholding crosses regulatory thresholds.
detail: Jinkushal Industries Limited has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 10(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE. This regulation requires disclosure within two working days of acquisition of substantial shareholding (≥25% or on crossing specified thresholds). The PDF filing is archived on NSE corporate disclosures portal. Specific acquirer, consideration, and shareholding percentage details require access to the filed disclosure document.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 – Regulation 10(5)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure of substantial acquisition within 2 working days; triggers public announcement and open offer requirements.
Defines 'substantial acquisition' (≥25% or crossing 25%/50%/75% thresholds) and 'person acting in concert' liability.
Open offer obligations triggered if acquirer holds ≥25% post-acquisition.
Consolidated shareholding disclosure and register of members; complements SEBI requirements.
Definition of 'acquisition' includes direct and beneficial ownership; relevant for determining threshold breach.
Regulator empowerment to frame takeover code; foundational statutory basis for SEBI regulations.
